mentions.name: Chat-with-page AI Chrome extension
mentions.description: A lightweight (<1MB) Chrome extension with over 600,000 downloads that lets users chat with the current page, draft emails and messages, fix grammar, translate, and summarize pages. It works with models from OpenAI, Google, and Anthropic, and supports using your own API key.
mentions.source_excerpt: I built a lightweight (<1mb) chrome extension (with over 600,000 downloads) that lets you chat with page, draft emails and messages, fix grammar, translate, summarize page, etc.. You can use models from OpenAl, Google, and Anthropic.
